     expires_at  DATETIME NOT NULL\n319\t    );\n320\t\";\n321\t\n322\t/// Split a SQL script into individual statements, respecting string literals,\n323\t/// quoted identifiers, and comments.\n324\t///\n325\t/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n326\t/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n327\t/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n328\t/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n329\t/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n330\t/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n331\t/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n332\t///\n333\t/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n334\t/// statement terminators.\n335\tfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n336\t    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n337\t    let len = bytes.len();\n338\t    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n339\t    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n340\t    let mut i = 0;\n341\t\n342\t    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n343\t    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n344\t    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n345\t    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n346\t    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n347\t\n348\t    while i < len {\n349\t        let b = bytes[i];\n350\t\n351\t        // --- Line comment state ---\n352\t        if in_line_comment {\n353\t            if b == b'\\n' {\n354\t                in_line_comment = false;\n355\t            }\n356\t            i += 1;\n357\t            continue;\n358\t        }\n359\t\n360\t        // --- Block comment state ---\n361\t        if in_block_comment {\n362\t            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n363\t                in_block_comment = false;\n364\t                i += 2;\n365\t            } else {\n366\t                i += 1;\n367\t            }\n368\t            continue;\n369\t        }\n370\t\n371\t        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n372\t        if in_single_quote {\n373\t            if b == b'\\'' {\n374\t                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n375\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n376\t                    i += 2;\n377\t                } else {\n378\t                    in_single_quote = false;\n379\t                    i += 1;\n380\t                }\n381\t            } else {\n382\t                i += 1;\n383\t            }\n384\t            continue;\n385\t        }\n386\t\n387\t        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n388\t        if in_double_quote {\n389\t            if b == b'\"' {\n390\t                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n391\t                    i += 2;\n392\t                } else {\n393\t                    in_double_quote = false;\n394\t                    i += 1;\n395\t                }\n396\t            } else {\n397\t                i += 1;\n398\t            }\n399\t            continue;\n400\t        }\n401\t\n402\t        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n403\t        if b == b'\\'' {\n404\t            in_single_quote = true;\n405\t            i += 1;\n406\t        } else if b == b'\"' {\n407\t            in_double_quote = true;\n408\t            i += 1;\n409\t        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n410\t            in_line_comment = true;\n411\t            i += 2;\n412\t        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n413\t            in_block_comment = true;\n414\t            i += 2;\n415\t        } else if b == b';' {\n416\t            // Statement terminator at top level.\n417\t            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n418\t            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n419\t                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n420\t            }\n421\t            start = i + 1;\n422\t            i += 1;\n423\t        } else {\n424\t            i += 1;\n425\t        }\n426\t    }\n427\t\n428\t    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n429\t    if start < len {\n430\t        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n431\t        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n432\t            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n433\t        }\n434\t    }\n435\t\n436\t    stmts\n437\t}\n438\t\n439\t/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\n440\tfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n441\t    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n442\t    Ok(())\n443\t}\n444\t\n445\tpub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n446\t    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n447\t    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n448\t    Ok(())\n449\t}\n450\t\n451\t/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n452\t/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\n453\tfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n454\t    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n455\t    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n456\t    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n457\t    let has_es: bool = conn\n458\t        .query_row(\n459\t            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE name='es'\",\n460\t            [],\n461\t            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n462\t        )\n463\t        .unwrap_or(false);\n464\t\n465\t    if !has_es {\n466\t        // Table has old schema - recreate with new schema\n467\t        conn.execute_batch(\n468\t            \"BEGIN;\n469\t             CREATE updated_at)\n479\t                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n480\t             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n481\t             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n482\t             COMMIT;\",\n483\t        )?;\n484\t    }\n485\t\n486\t    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n487\t    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n488\t        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n489\t         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_float ON critical_path_cache(float);\",\n490\t    );\n491\t\n492\t    // Migration 2: Add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing\n493\t    // Older databases may not have this column; br never reads worker_sessions so this is safe.\n494\t    let has_workspace_path: bool = conn\n495\t        .query_row(\n496\t            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE closed_at and duration_seconds to worker_sessions for velocity tracking\n510\t    let has_closed_at: bool = conn\n511\t        .query_row(\n512\t            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='closed_at'\",\n513\t            [],\n514\t            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n515\t        )\n516\t        .unwrap_or(false);\n517\t\n518\t    if !has_closed_at {\n519\t        conn.execute(\n520\t            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN closed_at DATETIME\",\n521\t            [],\n522\t        )?;\n523\t        conn.execute(\n524\t            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN duration_seconds INTEGER\",\n525\t            [],\n526\t        )?;\n527\t    }\n528\t\n529\t    Ok(())\n530\t}\n531\t\n532\tpub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n533\t    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n534\t    conn.execute_batch(\n535\t        \"PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;\n536\t         PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;\n537\t         PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000;\n538\t         PRAGMA cache_size = -8000;\n539\t identifiers, and comments.\n///\n/// A naive `split(';')` breaks when SQL string literals contain semicolons\n/// (e.g., `INSERT INTO t(v) VALUES('a;b')`). This function uses a small state\n/// machine to track whether the current position is inside:\n/// - A single-quoted string literal (`'...'`, with `''` as escape)\n/// - A double-quoted identifier (`\"...\"`, with `\"\"` as escape)\n/// - A line comment (`-- ...`)\n/// - A block comment (`/* ... */`)\n///\n/// Only semicolons at the top level (outside all of the above) are treated as\n/// statement terminators.\nfn split_sql_statements(sql: &str) -> Vec<&str> {\n    let bytes = sql.as_bytes();\n    let len = bytes.len();\n    let mut stmts = Vec::new();\n    let mut start = 0; // byte offset where the current statement begins\n    let mut i = 0;\n\n    // State flags — at most one is true at a time.\n    let mut in_single_quote = false;\n    let mut in_double_quote = false;\n    let mut in_line_comment = false;\n    let mut in_block_comment = false;\n\n    while i < len {\n        let b = bytes[i];\n\n        // --- Line comment state ---\n        if in_line_comment {\n            if b == b'\\n' {\n                in_line_comment = false;\n            }\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Block comment state ---\n        if in_block_comment {\n            if b == b'*' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'/' {\n                in_block_comment = false;\n                i += 2;\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Single-quoted string state ---\n        if in_single_quote {\n            if b == b'\\'' {\n                // '' is an escaped quote inside a string literal\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\\'' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_single_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Double-quoted identifier state ---\n        if in_double_quote {\n            if b == b'\"' {\n                if i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'\"' {\n                    i += 2;\n                } else {\n                    in_double_quote = false;\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            } else {\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // --- Top-level parsing ---\n        if b == b'\\'' {\n            in_single_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'\"' {\n            in_double_quote = true;\n            i += 1;\n        } else if b == b'-' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'-' {\n            in_line_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b'/' && i + 1 < len && bytes[i + 1] == b'*' {\n            in_block_comment = true;\n            i += 2;\n        } else if b == b';' {\n            // Statement terminator at top level.\n            let stmt = &sql[start..i];\n            if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n                stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n            }\n            start = i + 1;\n            i += 1;\n        } else {\n            i += 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Trailing statement without a final semicolon.\n    if start < len {\n        let stmt = &sql[start..len];\n        if !stmt.trim().is_empty() {\n            stmts.push(stmt.trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    stmts\n}\n\n/// Execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.\nfn execute_batch(conn: &Connection, sql: &str) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    conn.execute_batch(sql)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn apply_schema(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    execute_batch(conn, SCHEMA_SQL)?;\n    apply_migrations(conn)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Apply database migrations for schema changes.\n/// This handles adding new columns to existing tables.\nfn apply_migrations(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Migration 1: Update critical_path_cache schema if it has the old format\n    // Old format: bead_id, float (REAL), updated_at\n    // New format: bead_id, epic_id, es (INTEGER), ls (INTEGER), float (INTEGER), updated_at\n    let has_es: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('critical_path_cache') WHERE name='es'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_es {\n        // Table has old schema - recreate with new schema\n        conn.execute_batch(\n            \"BEGIN;\n             CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS critical_path_cache_new (\n                 bead_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n                 epic_id     TEXT,\n                 es          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 ls          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 float       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n                 updated_at  DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n                 FOREIGN KEY (bead_id) REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n             );\n             INSERT INTO critical_path_cache_new (bead_id, float, updated_at)\n                 SELECT bead_id, CAST(float AS INTEGER), updated_at FROM critical_path_cache;\n             DROP TABLE critical_path_cache;\n             ALTER TABLE critical_path_cache_new RENAME TO critical_path_cache;\n             COMMIT;\",\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Create indexes for critical_path_cache (idempotent)\n    let _ = conn.execute_batch(\n        \"CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_epic ON critical_path_cache(epic_id);\n         CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_critical_path_cache_float ON critical_path_cache(float);\",\n    );\n\n    // Migration 2: Add workspace_path to worker_sessions if missing\n    // Older databases may not have this column; br never reads worker_sessions so this is safe.\n    let has_workspace_path: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='workspace_path'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_workspace_path {\n        conn.execute(\n            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN workspace_path TEXT\",\n            [],\n        )?;\n    }\n\n    // Migration 3: Add closed_at and duration_seconds to worker_sessions for velocity tracking\n    let has_closed_at: bool = conn\n        .query_row(\n            \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('worker_sessions') WHERE name='closed_at'\",\n            [],\n            |row| row.get::<_, i64>(0).map(|n| n > 0),\n        )\n        .unwrap_or(false);\n\n    if !has_closed_at {\n        conn.execute(\n            \"ALTER TABLE worker_sessions ADD COLUMN closed_at Ok(())\n}\n\npub fn ensure_wal_mode(conn: &Connection) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    // Use execute_batch so PRAGMAs that return rows don't cause errors\n    conn.execute_batch(\n        \"PRAGMA Ok(())\n}\n","numLines":543,"startLine":1,"totalLines":543}}}

Aliases: parent -> blocker, child -> id (deprecated but supported)\n    ///\n    /// 3. close: Close a bead\n    ///    {\n    ///      \"op\": \"close\",\n    ///      \"id\": \"<string>\",               // required: bead ID to close\n    ///      \"reason\": \"<string>\"            // optional, default \"Completed\"\n    ///    }\n    ///\n    /// Placeholder references: Use @0, @1, @2... to envelope for --json output.\n///\n/// This helper creates the standard envelope shape that all bf commands emit:\n/// { version: 1, kind: \"<command>\", data: <data>, warning?: \"<msg>\" }\nfn wrap_envelope(kind: &str, data: serde_json::Value, warning: Option<&str>) -> String {\n    let envelope = crate::format::JsonEnvelope::new(kind, data);\n    let envelope = if let Some(w) = warning {\n        envelope.with_warning(w)\n    } else {\n        envelope\n    };\n    envelope.to_json().unwrap_or_else(|_| \"{}\".to_string())\n}\n\npub fn run_cli() -> Result<Cli> {\n    Ok(Cli::parse())\n}\n\npub fn run(cli: Cli) -> Result<()> {\n    // Captured before `cli.command` is moved out below. This is the\n    // per-invocation half of the effective auto-flush switch; combined with\n    // `config.sync.auto_flush` inside each handler via\n    // `autoflush::after_mutation_with_config` (see child 1, bf-37xjd).\n    let no_auto_flush = cli.no_auto_flush;\n    let workspace = cli.workspace.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(\".\"));\n\n    // Enable envelope wrapping for this process if --envelope flag is set.\n    // This is a process-wide setting that affects all JSON formatting.\n    if cli.envelope {\n        crate::format::json::JsonFormatter::with_envelope_enabled();\n    }\n\n    // Handle case where no subcommand is provided\n    let command = match cli.command {\n        None => {\n            // clap handles --help automatically, exiting before this point\n            // If we reach here, it means no valid flag was provided\n            return Err(anyhow!(\n                \"No command provided. Use 'bf --help' for usage information.\"\n            ));\n        }\n        Some(cmd) => cmd,\n    };\n\n    // Handle Init command specially (doesn't require existing .beads directory)\n    if let Commands::Init { prefix } = &command {\n        let beads_dir = workspace.join(\".beads\");\n        return cmd_init(&beads_dir, prefix);\n    }\n\n    // Handle MergeJsonl specially: it operates on explicit file paths (as a git\n    // merge driver would) and must not require a discoverable .beads directory.\n    if let Commands::MergeJsonl {\n        base,\n        ours,\n        theirs,\n        output,\n    } = &command\n    {\n        return cmd_merge_jsonl(&workspace, base.as_deref(), ours, theirs, output.as_deref());\n    }\n\n    // All other commands require existing .beads directory\n    let beads_dir = find_beads_dir(&workspace)\n        .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!(\"No .beads directory found in {:?}\", workspace))?;\n\n    match command {\n        Commands::Create {\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n            json,\n        } => cmd_create(\n            &beads_dir,\n            title,\n            type_,\n            priority,\n            description,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n            json,\n            no_auto_flush,\n        ),\n        Commands::List {\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            priority,\n            annotation,\n            limit,\n            all,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_list(\n                &beads_dir, status, type_, assignee, priority, annotation, limit, all, &format, cli.envelope,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Show { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_show(&beads_dir, &id, &format, cli.envelope)\n        }\n        Commands::Update {\n            id,\n            title,\n            status,\n            priority,\n            assignee,\n            clear_assignee,\n            description,\n            description_file,\n            acceptance_criteria,\n            notes,\n            design,\n            due_at,\n        } => {\n            // --clear-assignee is sugar for --assignee \"\": both flow the\n            // empty-string \"clear to NULL\" signal into update_issue. clap\n            // guarantees the two flags are mutually exclusive.\n            let assignee = if clear_assignee {\n                Some(String::new())\n            } else {\n                assignee\n            };\n            // --description-file resolves into `description` here (the REAL\n            // update path — cmd_update -> update_issue writes the column).\n            // clap's conflicts_with(\"description\") guarantees only one is set.\n            let description = match description_file {\n                Some(path) => Some(\n                    std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                        .map_err(|e| anyhow!(\"Failed to read --description-file {}: {}\", path.display(), e))?,\n                ),\n                None => description,\n            };\n            cmd_update(\n                &beads_dir,\n                &id,\n                title,\n                status,\n                priority,\n                assignee,\n                description,\n                acceptance_criteria,\n                notes,\n                design,\n                due_at,\n                no_auto_flush,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::Close { id, reason } => cmd_close(&beads_dir, &id, &reason, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Reopen { id } => cmd_reopen(&beads_dir, &id, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Delete { id } => cmd_delete(&beads_dir, &id, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Ready {\n            limit,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_ready(&beads_dir, limit, &format, cli.envelope)\n        }\n        Commands::Claim {\n            assignee,\n            model,\n            harness,\n            harness_version,\n            any,\n            fallback,\n            workspace_paths,\n            dry_run,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_claim(\n                &beads_dir,\n                &assignee,\n                model,\n                harness,\n                harness_version,\n Commands::Sync {\n            flush_only,\n            import_only,\n        } => cmd_sync(&beads_dir, flush_only, import_only),\n        // Handled specially before the .beads-directory requirement above.\n        Commands::MergeJsonl { .. } => unreachable!(\"MergeJsonl handled earlier\"),\n        Commands::Doctor {\n            repair,\n            flush_first,\n            force,\n            reclaim_stale,\n            ttl,\n            fix_schema,\n            allow_repeated_repair,\n            runs,\n            restore,\n        } => cmd_doctor(\n            &beads_dir,\n restore,\n        ),\n        Commands::CommitCheck => cmd_commit_check(&beads_dir),\n        Commands::Count { status } => cmd_count(&beads_dir, status),\n        Commands::Batch { file, json, stdin, format } => {\n            cmd_batch(&beads_dir, file, json, stdin, &format, no_auto_flush)\n        }\n        Commands::Mitosis {\n            id,\n            children,\n            reason,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_mitosis(&beads_dir, &id, &children, &reason, &format, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Dep(dep) => cmd_dep(&beads_dir, dep, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Label(label) => cmd_label(&beads_dir, label, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Comments(comments) => cmd_comments(&beads_dir, comments, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Search {\n            query,\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n            priority_min,\n            priority_max,\n            limit,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_search(\n            &beads_dir,\n            query,\n            status,\n            type_,\n            assignee,\n            label,\n            priority_min,\n            priority_max,\n            limit,\n            &format,\n            cli.envelope,\n        ),\n        Commands::Stats {\n            by_type,\n            by_priority,\n            by_assignee,\n            by_label,\n            format,\n            envelope,\n        } => cmd_stats(\n            &beads_dir,\n            by_type,\n            by_priority,\n            by_assignee,\n            by_label,\n            &format,\n            envelope,\n        ),\n        Commands::Schema { target, format } => cmd_schema(&target, &format),\n        Commands::Config(config) => cmd_config(&beads_dir, config),\n        Commands::Velocity {\n            model,\n            harness,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_velocity(&beads_dir, model, harness, &format),\n        Commands::Labels { id, format, json } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n            cmd_labels(&beads_dir, id.as_deref(), &format)\n        }\n        Commands::Annotate(annotate) => cmd_annotate(&beads_dir, annotate, no_auto_flush),\n        Commands::Log {\n            id,\n            limit,\n            since,\n            actor,\n            status_changes,\n            diff,\n            git,\n            format,\n            json,\n        } => {\n            let format = if json { \"json\".to_string() } else { format };\n    git,\n                &format,\n            )\n        }\n        Commands::CriticalPath {\n            id,\n            max_depth,\n            format,\n        } => cmd_critical_path(&beads_dir, SUCCESSFUL single-issue mutation.\n///\n/// This is the shared wiring for Phase 7.1 child 2/5 (bf-3iosi): every\n/// single-issue mutation handler calls this once its storage write has\n/// committed. It honors the effective auto-flush switch\n/// (`config.sync.auto_flush && !--no-auto-flush`) via child 1's\n/// [`crate::autoflush::after_mutation_with_config`].\n///\n/// A flush failure NEVER fails the mutation — the write already succeeded and\n/// the flush layer retains the `dirty_issues` marks so the next flush (or\n/// `bf sync --flush-only`) recovers. On failure we emit a stderr warning and\n/// return the warning text so a `--json` caller can also fold it into its\n/// output envelope via [`crate::format::with_warning`]. Returns `None` when\n/// auto-flush is disabled or the flush succeeded.\nfn autoflush_after_mutation(\n    beads_dir: &Path,\n    config: &Config,\n    no_auto_flush: bool,\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let outcome = crate::autoflush::after_mutation_with_config(beads_dir, config, no_auto_flush);\n    surface_flush_outcome(&outcome)\n}\n\n/// Like [`autoflush_after_mutation`] but for a hard delete: prunes the deleted\n/// beads' now-stale lines from JSONL via [`crate::autoflush::after_delete`]\n/// (the FK cascade drops their `dirty_issues` rows, so an ordinary dirty flush\n/// could never remove them). Best-effort — a flush failure never fails the\n/// delete; it degrades to a stderr warning and the returned text.\nfn autoflush_after_delete(\n    beads_dir: &Path,\n    config: &Config,\n    no_auto_flush: bool,\n    removed_ids: &[String],\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let enabled = crate::autoflush::enabled(config, no_auto_flush);\n    let outcome = crate::autoflush::after_delete(beads_dir, enabled, removed_ids);\n    surface_flush_outcome(&outcome)\n}\n\n/// Bridge a [`crate::autoflush::FlushOutcome`] into the user-facing warning\n/// channel: &crate::autoflush::FlushOutcome) -> Option<String> {\n    match outcome.warning() {\n        Some(w) => {\n            crate::format::warn_stderr(w);\n            Some(w.to_string())\n        }\n        None => None,\n    }\n}\n\nfn cmd_create(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    title: String,\n    type_: String,\n    priority: i32,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    labels: Vec<String>,\n    json: bool,\n    no_auto_flush: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    let count = storage.count_issues()?;\n    let prefix = get_default_prefix(&config);\n\n Priority(priority);\n    issue.description = description;\n    // Normalize empty/whitespace-only to None so `bf create --assignee ''`\n    // creates a bead with no assignee instead of a literal empty string.\n    issue.assignee = normalize_assignee(assignee.as_deref());\n    issue.labels = labels;\n\n    // Short IDs are sized for ~1% collision probability by design\n    // (id::optimal_hash_length), so a colliding INSERT is an expected\n    // event: re-roll the ID instead of failing the create.\n    let mut id = String::new();\n    let mut created = false;\n    let mut last_err = None;\n    for _ in 0..5 {\n        id = crate::id::generate_id(prefix, count);\n        issue.id = id.clone();\n        match storage.create_issue(&issue) {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                created = true;\n                break;\n            }\n            Err(e)\n                if e.to_string()\n                    .contains(\"UNIQUE constraint failed: issues.id\") =>\n            {\n                last_err = Some(e);\n            }\n            Err(e) => return Err(e),\n        }\n    }\n    if !created {\n        return Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!(\"ID collision retries exhausted\")));\n    }\n\n    // Incremental flush of the just-created bead (best effort; never fatal).\n    let warning = autoflush_after_mutation(beads_dir, &config, no_auto_flush);\n\n    if json {\n        let formatter = get_formatter(OutputFormat::Json);\n        let data = serde_json::json!({ \"id\": id });\n        let json_str =  Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_list(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    type_: Option<String>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    annotation: Option<String>,\n    limit: Option<usize>,\n    all: bool,\n    format: &str,\n    envelope: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    // Parse annotation filter (key=value format)\n    let annotation_filter = match annotation {\n        Some(ref ann) => {\n            let parts: Vec<&str> = ann.splitn(2, '=').collect();\n            if parts.len() != 2 {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Invalid annotation format. Use key=value\"));\n            }\n            Some((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))\n        }\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    let mut issues = if all {\n        // Include archived beads\n Some(IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?);\n        }\n        filter.assignee = assignee.clone();\n        filter.priority = priority;\n        filter.annotation = annotation_filter.clone();\n        // --limit 0 means unlimited\n        filter.limit = limit.and_then(|l| if l == 0 { None } else { Some(l) });\n        storage.list_issues(&filter)?\n    };\n\n    // Apply additional filters for --all mode (since we're not using DB filters)\n    if all {\n        if let Some(ref s) = status {\n            let status_filter = Status::from_str(s.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.status == status_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref t) = type_ {\n            let type_filter = IssueType::from_str(t.as_str()).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))?;\n            issues.retain(|i| i.issue_type == type_filter);\n        }\n        if let Some(ref assignee_val) = assignee {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.assignee.as_deref() == Some(assignee_val));\n        }\n        if let Some(p) = priority {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.priority.0 == p);\n        }\n        if let Some((ref key, ref value)) = annotation_filter {\n            issues.retain(|i| i.annotations.get(key).map_or(false, |v| v == value));\n        }\n        // Apply limit\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            if l != 0 {\n                issues.truncate(l);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let       // Wrap in envelope with kind=\"list\"\n                // Convert JSONL to JSON array for envelope wrapping\n                let data = if jsonl.is_empty() {\n                    \"[]\".to_string()\n                } else {\n                    // Convert JSONL (one object per line) to JSON array\n                    let objects: Vec<serde_json::Value> = jsonl\n                        .lines()\n                        .filter_map(|line| serde_json::from_str(line).ok())\n                        .collect();\n                    serde_json::to_string(&objects).unwrap_or_else(|_| \"[]\".to_string())\n                };\n                println!(\"{}\", formatter.format_with_envelope(\"list\", &data));\n            } else {\n                // Raw JSONL output; empty list prints []\n                if jsonl.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"[]\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"{}\", jsonl);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            print!(\"{}\", formatter.format_issues(&issues));\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_show(beads_dir: Option<String>,\n    status: Option<String>,\n    priority: Option<i32>,\n    assignee: Option<String>,\n    description: Option<String>,\n    acceptance_criteria: Option<String>,\n    notes: Option<String>,\n    design: Option<String>,\n    due_at: Option<String>,\n    no_auto_flush: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open_with_config(&db_path, &config)?;\n\n    // Note: an empty/whitespace `--assignee` is An empty\n    // `assignee` is the three-valued \"clear to NULL\" signal: update_issue's\n    // storage layer maps it to `assignee = NULL` (it never persists a literal\n    // empty string, which would read back as \"assigned\" and hide the bead from\n    // claiming). Defaulting `assignee` to None here would mean \"leave\n    // unchanged\", leaving a foreign assignee on a now-open bead.\n    let changes = IssueChanges {\n        status: Some(Status::Open),\n        assignee: Some(String::new()),\n        ..Default::default()\n    };\n\n    storage.update_issue(id, &changes)?;\n    autoflush_after_mutation(beads_dir, &config, no_auto_flush);\n    println!(\"Reopened bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_delete(beads_dir: &PathBuf, id: &str, no_auto_flush: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n        tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM issues WHERE id = ?\", [&id])?;\n        Ok(())\n    })?;\n\n    // The hard DELETE cascades away the bead's dirty_issues row, so a normal\n    // dirty flush can never remove its stale JSONL line. Prune it explicitly\n    // (best effort; a flush failure never fails the delete).\n    autoflush_after_delete(beads_dir, &config, no_auto_flush, &[id.to_string()]);\n\n    println!(\"Deleted bead {}\", id);\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_ready(beads_dir: &PathBuf, limit: usize, format: &str, envelope: bool) -> Result<()> {\n    let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n    let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n    let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n\n    // --limit 0 means unlimited (get_ready_candidates omits LIMIT clause when limit == 0)\n    let candidates =\n        storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, limit, None, None))?;\n\n    match format {\n        \"json\" => {\n            // Use the shared formatter for consistency with `list`/`search`.\n            // Resolve each scored candidate to its full Issue record so\n            // the formatter has every field; empty result prints `[]`.\n            let formatter = get_formatter(OutputFormat::Json);\n            let issues: Vec<Issue> = candidates\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|c| storage.get_issue(&c.id).ok().flatten())\n                .collect();\n\n            let jsonl = formatter.format_issues(&issues);\n            if envelope {\n                // Wrap in envelope with kind=\"ready\"\n                // Ensure empty results are \"[]\" not \"\" so format_with_envelope parses as array\n                let data = if jsonl.is_empty() { \"[]\".to_string() } else { jsonl };\n                println!(\"{}\", formatter.format_with_envelope(\"ready\", &data));\n            } else {\n                // Raw JSONL output; empty ready prints `[]` as a special case\n                if jsonl.is_empty() {\n                    println!(\"[]\");\n                } else {\n                    println!(\"{}\", jsonl);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        \"toon\" => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"{}\",\n                    crate::format::toon::format_ready_bead(\n                        &candidate.id,\n                        &candidate.title,\n                        candidate.priority,\n                        candidate.downstream_impact,\n                        candidate.critical_float,\n                    )\n                );\n            }\n        }\n        _ => {\n            for candidate in candidates {\n                println!(\n                    \"[{}] {} (priority={}, impact={}, float={})\",\n                    candidate.id,\n                    candidate.title,\n                    candidate.priority,\n                    candidate.downstream_impact,\n                    candidate.critical_float\n                );\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_claim(\n    beads_dir: &PathBuf,\n    assignee: &str,\n    model: Option<String>,\n    harness: Option<String>,\n    harness_version: Option<String>,\n    any: bool,\n    fallback: Option<&str>,\n    workspace_paths: &[PathBuf],\n    dry_run: bool,\n    format: &str,\n    no_auto_flush: bool,\n) -> Result<()> {\n    let config = load_config(beads_dir)?;\n    let claim_ttl = config.claim_ttl_minutes;\n\n    // Pre-resolved auto-flush switch; each successful (non-dry-run) claim flushes\n    // the workspace whose bead it mutated. `flush_claim` targets that workspace\n    // (which may differ from `beads_dir` under `--any`/fallback) and surfaces a\n    // flush failure as a warning without failing the claim.\n    let flush_enabled = crate::autoflush::enabled(&config, no_auto_flush);\n    let flush_claim = |ws: &Path| {\n        let outcome = crate::autoflush::after_mutation(ws, flush_enabled);\n        surface_flush_outcome(&outcome);\n    };\n\n    let output_format = OutputFormat::from_str(format).unwrap_or(OutputFormat::Text);\n    let formatter = get_formatter(output_format);\n\n    // Build worker metadata\n    let worker_metadata = WorkerMetadata {\n        worker_id: assignee.to_string(),\n        model: model.clone(),\n        harness: harness.clone(),\n        harness_version: harness_version.clone(),\n    };\n\n    if dry_run {\n        // Dry run mode - show what would be claimed\n        let candidates: Vec<(PathBuf, crate::claim::ScoredBead)> = if any || fallback == Some(\"any\")\n        {\n            // Multi-workspace dry run\n            let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n                // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n                find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n            } else {\n                workspace_paths.to_vec()\n            };\n\n            let mut all_candidates = Vec::new();\n            for path in &paths {\n                let local_beads_dir = path.join(\".beads\");\n                if local_beads_dir.exists() {\n                    let local_metadata = match load_metadata(&local_beads_dir) {\n                        Ok(m) => m,\n                        Err(_) => continue,\n                    };\n                    let local_db_path = local_beads_dir.join(&local_metadata.database);\n                    if let Ok(local_storage) = Storage::open(&local_db_path) {\n                        if let Ok(local_candidates) =\n                            local_storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n                                get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None)\n                            })\n                        {\n                            for c in local_candidates {\n                                all_candidates.push((path.clone(), c));\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Sort by score and take top 1\n            all_candidates.sort_by(|a, b| {\n                let score_a = (b.1.downstream_impact, b.1.priority, b.1.created_at.clone());\n                let score_b = (a.1.downstream_impact, a.1.priority, a.1.created_at.clone());\n                score_a.cmp(&score_b)\n            });\n            all_candidates.into_iter().take(1).collect()\n        } else {\n            // Single workspace dry run\n            let metadata = load_metadata(beads_dir)?;\n            let db_path = beads_dir.join(&metadata.database);\n            let storage = Storage::open(&db_path)?;\n            let candidates =\n                storage.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| get_ready_candidates(tx, 1, None, None))?;\n            candidates\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|c| (beads_dir.parent().unwrap_or(beads_dir).to_path_buf(), c))\n                .collect()\n        };\n\n        if let Some((path, candidate)) = candidates.first() {\n            let mut out = ClaimResultOutput::new(&candidate.id, assignee);\n            out.title = Some(candidate.title.clone());\n            out.priority = Some(candidate.priority);\n            out.downstream_impact = Some(candidate.downstream_impact);\n            out.workspace = Some(path.display().to_string());\n            out.dry_run = Some(true);\n            println!(\"{}\", formatter.format_claim_result(&out));\n        } else {\n            println!(\"{}\", formatter.format_no_claim());\n        }\n    } else if any {\n        // Claim from any workspace\n        let paths = if workspace_paths.is_empty() {\n            // Auto-discover workspaces from current directory\n            find_workspaces(&std::env::current_dir()?)?\n        } else {\n            workspace_paths.to_vec()\n        };\n\n        let result = claim_any(&paths, assignee, fn update_issue(&self, id: &str, changes: &IssueChanges) -> Result<()> {\n        // Validate that the bead exists\n        let exists = {\n            let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n            match conn.query_row(\"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\", params![id], |_| {\n                Ok(true)\n            }) {\n                Ok(result) => result,\n                Err(rusqlite::Error::QueryReturnedNoRows) => false,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e.into()),\n            }\n        };\n        if !exists {\n            return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n        }\n\n        // Scan for secrets before updating (only for string fields in changes)\n        if let Some(scanner) = &*self.secret_scanner.lock().unwrap() {\n            let mut            if let Some(labels) = &changes.labels {\n                for label in labels {\n                    all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(label));\n                }\n            }\n all_matches.extend(scanner.scan_string(value));\n                }\n            }\n            if !all_matches.is_empty() {\n                return Err(SecretError(format_secret_matches(&all_matches)).into());\n            }\n        }\n\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Get current status before update (for reopen detection)\n            let current_status: Option<Status> = tx.query_row(\n                \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                params![id],\n                |row| {\n                    let status_str: String = row.get(0)?;\n                    Ok(match status_str.as_str() {\n                        \"open\" => Status::Open,\n                        \"in_progress\" => Status::InProgress,\n                        \"blocked\" => Status::Blocked,\n                        \"deferred\" => Status::Deferred,\n                        \"draft\" => Status::Draft,\n                        \"closed\" => Status::Closed,\n                        \"tombstone\" => Status::Tombstone,\n                        \"pinned\" => Status::Pinned,\n                        _ => Status::Custom(status_str),\n                    })\n                },\n            ).ok();\n\n            // Current assignee before update (for assignee-change events)\n            let current_assignee: Option<String> = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT assignee FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |row| row.get(0),\n                )\n                .ok()\n                .flatten();\n\n            let mut updates = Vec::new();\n            let mut params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = Vec::new();\n            if let Some(ref title) = changes.title {\n                updates.push(\"title = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(title.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref description) = changes.description {\n                updates.push(\"description = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(description.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref design) = changes.design {\n                updates.push(\"design = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(design.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref acceptance_criteria) = changes.acceptance_criteria {\n                updates.push(\"acceptance_criteria = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(acceptance_criteria.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref notes) = changes.notes {\n                updates.push(\"notes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(notes.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref status) = changes.status {\n                updates.push(\"status = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(status.to_string()));\n                // Clear closed fields when transitioning from closed/tombstone to open\n                if !matches!(status, Status::Closed | Status::Tombstone) {\n                    updates.push(\"closed_at = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"close_reason = NULL\");\n                    updates.push(\"closed_by_session = NULL\");\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(priority) = changes.priority {\n                updates.push(\"priority = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(priority));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref issue_type) = changes.issue_type {\n                updates.push(\"issue_type = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(issue_type.to_string()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                if assignee.trim().is_empty() {\n                    // Clearing stores NULL, never an empty string that would\n                    // read back as \"assigned\" and hide the bead from claiming.\n                    updates.push(\"assignee = NULL\");\n                } else {\n                    updates.push(\"assignee = ?\");\n                    params.push(Box::new(assignee.clone()));\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(ref owner) = changes.owner {\n                updates.push(\"owner = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(owner.clone()));\n            }\n            if let Some(estimated_minutes) = changes.estimated_minutes {\n                updates.push(\"estimated_minutes = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(estimated_minutes));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref due_at) = changes.due_at {\n                updates.push(\"due_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(due_at.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref defer_until) = changes.defer_until {\n                updates.push(\"defer_until = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(defer_until.to_rfc3339()));\n            }\n            if let Some(ref external_ref) = changes.external_ref {\n                updates.push(\"external_ref = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(external_ref.clone()));\n            }\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            if !updates.is_empty() {\n                updates.push(\"updated_at = ?\");\n                params.push(Box::new(now.to_rfc3339()));\n                let query = format!(\"UPDATE issues SET {} WHERE id = ?\", updates.join(\", \"));\n                let mut all_params: Vec<Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>> = params.into_iter().collect();\n                all_params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()));\n                let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> =\n                    all_params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n                tx.execute(&query, param_refs.as_slice())?;\n\n                // Create a Reopened event if transitioning from closed/tombstone to active status\n                if let (Some(current), Some(new)) = (current_status, changes.status.as_ref()) {\n                    if current.is_terminal() && !new.is_terminal() {\n                        let actor = changes.actor.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"system\");\n                        let now = Utc::now();\n                        tx.execute(\n                            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'reopened', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                            params![id, actor, current.as_str(), new.as_str(), now.to_rfc3339()],\n                        )?;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // br parity: record an assignee_changed event when the assignee changes\n                if let Some(ref new_assignee) = changes.assignee {\n                    let new_val = if new_assignee.trim().is_empty() {\n                        None\n                    } else {\n                        Some(new_assignee.as_str())\n                    };\n                    if current_assignee.as_deref() != new_val {\n                        let actor = changes.actor.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"cli\");\n                        tx.execute(\n                            \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'assignee_changed', ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5)\",\n                            params![id, actor, current_assignee.as_deref(), new_val, Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n                        )?;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle label updates separately\n            if let Some(ref labels) = changes.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![id])?;\n                for label in labels {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO labels (issue_id, label) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![id, label],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Handle annotation updates separately\n            if let Some(ref annotations) = changes.annotations {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"DELETE FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                )?;\n                for (key, value) in annotations {\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO bead_annotations (bead_id, key, value) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)\",\n                        params![id, key, value],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n            // Mark as dirty for export (if any changes were made)\n            if !updates.is_empty() || changes.labels.is_some() || changes.annotations.is_some() {\n                tx.execute(\n                    \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                    params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                )?;\n            }\n            // Invalidate critical path cache if status changed (affects dependency graph)\n            if changes.status.is_some() {\n                invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n                compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Update an issue from JSONL import data.\n    ///\n    /// This replaces all fields of the existing issue with the imported data,\n    /// used during JSONL import when the content_hash differs.\n    pub fn update_issue_from_json(&self, issue: &Issue) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Delete existing related data\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![&issue.id])?;\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![&issue.id])?;\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM comments WHERE issue_id = ?1\", params![&issue.id])?;\n\n            // Update the issue row with all fields\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET\n                    content_hash = ?1, title = ?2, description = ?3, design = ?4,\n                    acceptance_criteria = ?5, notes = ?6, status = ?7, priority =         close_reason = ?17, closed_by_session = ?18, due_at = ?19, defer_until = ?20,\n                    external_ref = ?21, source_system = ?22, source_repo = ?23,\n                    deleted_at = ?24, deleted_by = ?25, delete_reason = ?26, original_type = ?27,\n                    compaction_level = ?28, compacted_at = ?29, compacted_at_commit = ?30,\n                    original_size = ?31, sender = ?32, ephemeral = ?33, pinned = ?34, is_template = ?35\n                 WHERE id = ?36\",\n                params![\n                    &issue.content_hash, &issue.title,\n                    issue.description.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.design.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.acceptance_criteria.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    issue.notes.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"\"),\n                    &issue.status.to_string(),\n                    &issue.priority, &issue.issue_type.to_string(), &issue.assignee, &issue.owner,\n                    &issue.estimated_minutes, &issue.created_at.to_rfc3339(), &issue.created_by,\n                    &issue.updated_at.to_rfc3339(), issue.closed_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()),\n                    &issue.close_reason, &issue.closed_by_session, issue.due_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()),\n                    issue.defer_until.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()), &issue.external_ref, &issue.source_system,\n                    issue.source_repo.as_deref().unwrap_or(\".\"),\n                    issue.deleted_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()), &issue.deleted_by,\n                    &issue.delete_reason, &issue.original_type, &issue.compaction_level,\n                    issue.compacted_at.map(|d| d.to_rfc3339()), &issue.compacted_at_commit,\n                    &issue.original_size, &issue.sender,\n                    if issue.ephemeral { 1 } else { 0 },\n                    if issue.pinned { 1 } else { 0 },\n                    if issue.is_template { 1 } else { 0 },\n                    &issue.id,\n                ],\n            )?;\n\n            // Re-insert labels, dependencies, and comments\n            for label in &issue.labels {\n                tx.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE close_issue(&self, id: &str, reason: &str, actor: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            // Check if bead exists\n            let exists: bool = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT 1 FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |_| Ok(true),\n                )\n                .unwrap_or(false);\n            if !exists {\n                return Err(anyhow!(\"Bead not found: {}\", id));\n            }\n\n            // Check if already closed for idempotence\n            let current_status: Option<String> = tx\n                .query_row(\n                    \"SELECT status FROM issues WHERE id = ?1\",\n                    params![id],\n                    |row| row.get(0),\n                )\n                .ok();\n\n            if current_status.as_deref() == Some(\"closed\") {\n                // Already closed - idempotent, return success\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n\n            // Close the bead\n            let now = Utc::now();\n            tx.execute(\n                \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ?, close_reason = ?, closed_by_session = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?\",\n                params![now.to_rfc3339(), reason, actor, now.to_rfc3339(), id],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'closed', ?2, NULL, ?3, ?4)\",\n                params![id, actor, reason, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                params![id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            // Update worker session with close time and duration for velocity tracking\n            crate::velocity::update_session_on_close(tx, id, now)?;\n\n            // Cascade status transition: find dependents that should move from blocked->open\n            // A dependent should be unblocked if it has no remaining blockers in non-terminal status\n            let dependents: Vec<(String, String)> = tx\n                .prepare(\n                    \"SELECT d.issue_id, i.status\n                     FROM dependencies d\n                     INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.issue_id\n                     WHERE d.depends_on_id = ?1\n                     AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\",\n                )?\n                .query_map(params![id], |row| {\n                    Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))\n                })?\n                .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n            for (dep_id, dep_status) in dependents {\n                // Only transition beads currently at status='blocked'\n                if dep_status != \"blocked\" {\n                    continue;\n                }\n\n                // Check if the dependent has any OTHER remaining blockers not in terminal status\n                let remaining_blockers: i64 = tx\n                    .query_row(\n                        r#\"\n                        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.depends_on_id)\n                        FROM dependencies d\n                        INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                        WHERE d.issue_id = ?1\n                        AND d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                        AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n                        \"#,\n                        params![&dep_id],\n                        |row| row.get(0),\n                    )\n                    .unwrap_or(0);\n\n                // If no remaining blockers, transition to 'open'\n                if remaining_blockers == 0 {\n                    let now = Utc::now();\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"UPDATE issues SET status = 'open', updated_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2\",\n                        params![now.to_rfc3339(), &dep_id],\n                    )?;\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT INTO events (issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, created_at) VALUES (?1, 'status_changed', 'system', 'blocked', 'open', ?2)\",\n                        params![&dep_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                    )?;\n                    tx.execute(\n                        \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n                        params![&dep_id, now.to_rfc3339()],\n                    )?;\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Rebuild blocked_issues_cache to reflect the new blocker state\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n                 SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n                 FROM dependencies d\n                 INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                 WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')\n                 GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n                params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n\n            // Invalidate critical path cache: closing a bead can unblock dependents\n            invalidate_cache(tx)?;\n            compute_all_critical_paths(tx)?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn mark_dirty(&self, id: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let now = Utc::now().to_rfc3339();\n        conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT OR REPLACE INTO dirty_issues (issue_id, marked_at) VALUES (?1, ?2)\",\n            params![id, now],\n        )?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    pub fn rebuild_blocked_cache(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            tx.execute(\"DELETE FROM blocked_issues_cache\", [])?;\n\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO blocked_issues_cache (issue_id, blocked_by, blocked_at)\n                 SELECT d.issue_id, '[' || GROUP_CONCAT('\\\"' || d.depends_on_id || '\\\"') || ']' AS blocked_by, ?1\n                 FROM dependencies d\n                 INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = d.depends_on_id\n                 WHERE d.type IN ('blocks', 'parent-child', 'conditional-blocks', 'waits-for')\n                 AND i.status NOT IN ('closed', 'tombstone', 'done', 'completed')  -- TERMINAL_STATUS_SQL_LIST\n                 GROUP BY d.issue_id\",\n                params![Utc::now().to_rfc3339()],\n            )?;\n            Ok(())\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Get all beads currently in the blocked_issues_cache.\n    ///\n    /// Returns a list of (issue_id, blocked_by) tuples where blocked_by is\n    /// a JSON array of blocker IDs.\n    pub fn get_blocked_issues(&self) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, blocked_by FROM blocked_issues_cache ORDER BY issue_id\"\n        )?;\n\n        let result = stmt\n            .query_map([], |row| {\n                Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?))\n            })?\n            .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;\n\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n\n    pub fn count_issues(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let count: i64 = conn.query_row(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues\", [], |row| row.get(0))?;\n        Ok(count as usize)\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_from_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path) -> Result<ImportResult> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            import_jsonl(jsonl_path, |issue| {\n                let existing = Self::get_issue_tx(tx, &issue.id)?;\n                match existing {\n                    None => {\n                        Self::create_issue_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                        Ok(UpsertResult::New)\n                    }\n                    Some(existing_issue) => {\n                        // Compute hash from incoming issue (content_hash is None from JSONL due to #[serde(skip)])\n                        let incoming_hash = issue.content_hash();\n                        if existing_issue.content_hash.as_ref() != Some(&incoming_hash) {\n                            Self::update_issue_from_json_tx(tx, issue)?;\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Updated)\n                        } else {\n                            Ok(UpsertResult::Unchanged)\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            })\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn sync_to_jsonl(&self, jsonl_path: &Path, dirty_only: bool) -> Result<usize> {\n        if dirty_only {\n            let result = export_jsonl_dirty(\n                jsonl_path,\n                || self.list_dirty_issues(),\n                || self.clear_dirty(),\n            )?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        } else {\n            let result = export_jsonl(jsonl_path, || self.list_all_issues())?;\n            // Clear dirty flags after full export (all beads are now synced)\n            self.clear_dirty()?;\n            Ok(result.count)\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_issue_conn(conn: &Connection, row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Issue> {\n        let status_str: String = row.get(7)?;\n        let type_str: String = row.get(9)?;\n        let parse_opt_dt = |idx: usize| -> Result<Option<DateTime<Utc>>> {\n            let s: Option<String> = row.get(idx)?;\n            match s {\n                None => Ok(None),\n                Some(ref val) if val.is_empty() => Ok(None),\n                Some(val) => Ok(Some(parse_datetime(val)?)),\n            }\n        };\n        let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n        Ok(Issue {\n            content_hash: row.get(1)?,\n            title: row.get(2)?,\n            description: row.get(3)?,\n            design: row.get(4)?,\n            acceptance_criteria: row.get(5)?,\n            notes: row.get(6)?,\n            status: Status::from_str(&status_str).unwrap_or(Status::Custom(status_str)),\n            priority: row.get(8)?,\n            issue_type: IssueType::from_str(&type_str).unwrap_or(IssueType::Custom(type_str)),\n            assignee: row.get(10)?,\n            owner: row.get(11)?,\n            estimated_minutes: row.get(12)?,\n            created_at: parse_required_datetime(row.get(13)?)?,\n            created_by: row.get(14)?,\n            updated_at: parse_required_datetime(row.get(15)?)?,\n            closed_at: parse_opt_dt(16)?,\n            close_reason: row.get(17)?,\n            closed_by_session: row.get(18)?,\n            due_at: parse_opt_dt(19)?,\n            defer_until: parse_opt_dt(20)?,\n            external_ref: row.get(21)?,\n            source_system: row.get(22)?,\n            source_repo: row.get(23)?,\n            deleted_at: parse_opt_dt(24)?,\n            deleted_by: row.get(25)?,\n            delete_reason: row.get(26)?,\n            original_type: row.get(27)?,\n            compaction_level: row.get(28)?,\n            compacted_at: parse_opt_dt(29)?,\n            compacted_at_commit: row.get(30)?,\n            original_size: row.get(31)?,\n            sender: row.get(32)?,\n            ephemeral: row.get::<_, i32>(33)? != 0,\n            pinned: row.get::<_, i32>(34)? != 0,\n            is_template: row.get::<_, i32>(35)? != 0,\n            labels: Self::load_labels_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            dependencies: Self::load_dependencies_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            comments: Self::load_comments_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            annotations: Self::load_annotations_conn(conn, &id)?,\n            id,\n        })\n    }\n\n    fn load_labels_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\"SELECT label FROM labels WHERE issue_id = ?1\")?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut labels = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            labels.push(row.get(0)?);\n        }\n        Ok(labels)\n    }\n\n    fn load_dependencies_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id, created_at, created_by FROM dependencies WHERE issue_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n            deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_required_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    fn load_comments_conn(conn: &Connection, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Comment>> {\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, author, text, created_at FROM comments WHERE issue_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut comments = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            comments.push(Comment {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                issue_id: row.get(1)?,\n                author: row.get(2)?,\n                body: row.get(3)?,\n                created_at: parse_required_datetime(row.get(4)?)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(comments)\n    }\n\n    fn load_annotations_conn(\n        conn: &Connection,\n        issue_id: &str,\n    ) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>> {\n        let mut stmt =\n            conn.prepare(\"SELECT key, value FROM bead_annotations WHERE bead_id = ?1\")?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![issue_id])?;\n        let mut annotations = BTreeMap::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let key: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let value: String = row.get(1)?;\n            annotations.insert(key, value);\n        }\n        Ok(annotations)\n    }\n\n    fn load_labels(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        Self::load_labels_conn(&conn, issue_id)\n    }\n\n    fn load_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> issue_id: &str,\n        depends_on_id: &str,\n        dep_type: &DependencyType,\n        created_by: &str,\n    ) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            let now params![issue_id, depends_on_id, dep_type.to_string(), now.to_rfc3339(), created_by],\n            )?;\n            // The dependency is stored on issue_id's record and exported with it.\n get_dependencies(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        self.load_dependencies(issue_id)\n    }\n\n    /// Get dependency tree rooted at an issue using recursive CTE.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// * `root_id` - The root issue ID\n    /// * `direction` - \"down\" for what this depends on, \"up\" for what depends on this\n    /// * `max_depth` - Maximum depth to traverse (0 = unlimited)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// Vector of tree nodes ordered by depth, suitable for tree display.\n    pub fn get_dep_tree(\n        &self,\n        root_id: &str,\n        direction: &str,\n        max_depth: usize,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<DepTreeNode>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n\n        // Build recursive CTE based on direction\n        let (anchor_join, recursive_join, id_col, dep_col) = match direction {\n            \"up\" => {\n                // \"up\" means: find issues that depend on this one\n                // Anchor: issues that directly depend on root\n                // Recursive: issues that depend on those\n                (\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                )\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // \"down\" (default): what this issue depends on\n                // Anchor: issues that root directly depends on\n                // Recursive: issues that those depend on\n                (\n                    \"d.issue_id = ?1\",\n                    \"d.issue_id = rec.id\",\n                    \"d.depends_on_id\",\n                    \"d.issue_id\",\n                )\n            }\n        };\n\n        let depth_limit = if max_depth == 0 {\n            String::new()\n        } else {\n            format!(\"AND rec.depth < {}\", max_depth)\n        };\n\n        let sql = format!(\n            \"WITH RECURSIVE dep_tree AS (\n                -- Anchor: direct dependencies/dependents of root\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    0 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    '{root_id}' || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                WHERE {anchor_join}\n\n                UNION ALL\n\n                -- Recursive: dependencies of dependencies\n                SELECT\n                    {id_col} as id,\n                    i.title,\n                    i.status,\n                    i.priority,\n                    rec.depth + 1 as depth,\n                    d.type as dep_type,\n                    rec.path || ',' || {id_col} as path\n                FROM dependencies d\n                INNER JOIN issues i ON i.id = {id_col}\n                INNER JOIN dep_tree rec ON {recursive_join}\n                WHERE rec.path NOT LIKE '%' || {id_col} || '%'\n                {depth_limit}\n            )\n            SELECT id, title, status, priority, depth, dep_type, path\n            FROM dep_tree\n            ORDER BY depth, id\"\n        );\n\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![root_id])?;\n        let mut nodes = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let path: String = row.get(6)?;\n            // Detect cycles: if the ID appears more than once in path, it's a cycle\n            let id: String = row.get(0)?;\n            let is_cycle = path.matches(&id).count() > 1;\n\n            nodes.push(DepTreeNode {\n                id: row.get(0)?,\n                title: row.get(1)?,\n                status: row.get(2)?,\n                priority: row.get(3)?,\n                depth: row.get(4)?,\n                dep_type: row.get::<_, Option<String>>(5)?,\n                path: if is_cycle {\n                    format!(\"{} [CYCLE]\", path)\n                } else {\n                    path\n                },\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(nodes)\n    }\n\n    pub fn get_dependents(&self, depends_on_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Dependency>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT issue_id, depends_on_id, type, metadata, thread_id, created_at, created_by FROM dependencies WHERE depends_on_id = ?1\",\n        )?;\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(params![depends_on_id])?;\n        let mut deps = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            let type_str: String = row.get(2)?;\n            deps.push(Dependency {\n                issue_id: row.get(0)?,\n                depends_on_id: row.get(1)?,\n                dep_type: DependencyType::from_str(&type_str)\n                    .unwrap_or(DependencyType::Custom(type_str)),\n                metadata: row\n                    .get::<_, Option<String>>(3)?\n                    .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()),\n                thread_id: row.get(4)?,\n                created_at: parse_required_datetime(row.get(5)?)?,\n                created_by: row.get(6)?,\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(deps)\n    }\n\n    pub fn add_label(&self, issue_id: &str, label: &str) -> Result<()> {\n        self.with_immediate_transaction(|tx| {\n            tx.execute(\n                \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO labels // Event methods\n    pub fn list_events(&self, issue_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(\n            \"SELECT id,    }\n\n    pub fn list_events_filtered(\n        &self,\n        issue_id: Option<&str>,\n        since: Option<&DateTime<Utc>>,\n        actor: Option<&str>,\n        event_type: Option<&EventType>,\n        limit: Option<usize>,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let mut sql = String::from(\n            \"SELECT id, issue_id, event_type, actor, old_value, new_value, comment, created_at\n             FROM events WHERE 1=1\",\n        );\n        let mut params = Vec::new();\n        let mut param_idx = 1;\n\n        if let Some(id) = issue_id {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND issue_id = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(id.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(dt) = since {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND created_at >= ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(dt.to_rfc3339()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(a) = actor {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND actor = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(a.to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        if let Some(et) = event_type {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" AND event_type = ?{}\", param_idx));\n            params.push(Box::new(et.as_str().to_string()) as Box<dyn rusqlite::ToSql>);\n            param_idx += 1;\n        }\n        sql.push_str(\" ORDER BY created_at ASC\");\n        if let Some(l) = limit {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\" LIMIT {}\", l));\n        }\n\n        let conn = self.conn.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut stmt = conn.prepare(&sql)?;\n        let param_refs: Vec<&dyn rusqlite::ToSql> = params.iter().map(|p| p.as_ref()).collect();\n        let mut rows = stmt.query(param_refs.as_slice())?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n        while let Some(row) = rows.next()? {\n            events.push(Self::row_to_event(row)?);\n        }\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn row_to_event(row: &rusqlite::Row) -> Result<Event> {\n        let type_str: String =
